question: Which Indian personality is known as the Mozart of Madras?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A. R Rahman**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A. R. Rahman is a renowned Indian music composer, singer, and songwriter.
 
• He is known as the Mozart of the Madras.
 
• He has won several national and international awards for his contribution to the music industry.
 
• Rahman is known for his unique fusion of Indian classical music with electronic music, world music, and traditional orchestral arrangements.
 
• He is also the first Indian to win two Academy Awards, two Grammy Awards, a BAFTA Award, and a Golden Globe for his work in the film Slumdog Millionaire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• K. J. Yesudas
 
 
• Full Name: Kattassery Joseph Yesudas
 
• Notable Contributions:
 
• Over 50,000 songs recorded in multiple languages, including Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, and Kannada.
 
• Renowned for his classical prowess, he bridged Carnatic music with film music.
 
• Recipient of numerous awards, including 8 National Film Awards for Best Male Playback Singer.
 
• Conferred the Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan by the Government of India.
 
 
 
• Kavita Krishnamurthy
 
 
• Full Name: Sharada Krishnamurthy
 
• Notable Contributions:
 
• Known for versatility in singing, with hits in Bollywood, devotional music, and classical fusions.
 
• Notable songs: "Hawa Hawai" (from Mr. India), "Pyar Hua Chupke Se" (from 1942: A Love Story), and "Aaj Main Upar".
 
• Winner of 4 Filmfare Awards for Best Female Playback Singer.
 
• Collaborated with legends like A.R. Rahman, R.D. Burman, and Lata Mangeshkar.
 
 
 
• Lata Mangeshkar
 
 
• Notable Contributions:
 
• Known as the "Nightingale of India," Lata recorded over 25,000 songs in 36 languages.
 
• Iconic songs include "Lag Jaa Gale", "Ajeeb Dastaan Hai Yeh", and "Tere Bina Zindagi Se".
 
• Winner of numerous awards, including Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor, and 3 National Film Awards.
 
• Her voice shaped the golden era of Indian cinema, spanning over seven decades
